shark_skin_tpu_85a_matte.structural_purpose: High-dexterity non-slip shop gloves (85A Matte TPU). Sliced at a dense 0.12mm layer height to sharply capture the swept-back V-shaped geometry of the dermal placoid scales. Implements a hardcoded 1.20mm extra retraction distance paired with a flat 0.00mm Z-hop lift and a slow 14.5 mm/s travel cap over the texture zones. This entirely counters nozzle pressure lag, preventing fuzzy stringing and securing clean fluid-channeling pathways.

impact_armor_tpu_95a_dense.structural_purpose: Heavy-duty impact protection gloves (95A Dense TPU). Sliced at a 0.16mm layer height to maximize structural wall interlocking around the auxetic dragonfly-wing knuckle cells. Holds zero Z-hop lift to prevent material peeling, ensuring maximum shock-dampening strength against sudden wrench slips or wrench-handling mechanical strikes.
